verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Insomnia issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials or tokens for an agent. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: RBAC controls which human users can access resources, SAML handles identity-provider login, external vault integration retrieves secrets for outgoing requests, and environments store user-supplied tokens.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
